status: Freeze before calculating all-design retrospective rankings; historical outcomes already exposed
selection: Use existing eight-event development scores and locked design only; no reselection using retrospective data
objective: Real compatible-range width, lower is better; invalid cases contribute width 2 exactly as the existing selection code
aggregation: Average eight blocks before bounds; average bands/lags within route then paired routes within earthquake then equal earthquakes

H0.definition: count of evaluation lags directly present

H1.definition: mean absolute distance from each target lag to nearest observed lag

H2.definition: maximum absolute distance from a target lag to its nearest observed lag

H3.use: descriptive association only, no preferred direction or selected design

H4.reason: No existing exact near-neighbour set {1,2,3,5,8,13} is defined as a selection rule; do not introduce it now

H5.reason: Optional structural baseline is not needed; no new condition-number/rank convention

rank.spearman_ties: average ranks, descriptive rho only, no p-values

inference: No conventional p-values or independent-design sample-size claim; no new bootstrap or uncertainty formulation

classification.order: B first for same/similar selection, then A, else C; D only for a central scientific contradiction
classification.B: Audit rank <= 5 and development-retrospective rho >= 0.5 and at least one H1/H2 choice identical or within 1% absolute relative J of audit; no superior selection claim
classification.A: Audit rank <= 5 and rho >= 0.5 and BOTH H1/H2 select distinct designs with J at least 5% larger than audit; H0 constancy alone is insufficient
classification.C: All remaining outcomes: incremental utility not demonstrated
classification.threshold_note: Transparent operational definitions for the review's qualitative high-rank/material-difference terms, frozen before new retrospective comparison; not new fitted thresholds

sensitivity: Lag-4 and lag-10 retrospective ranks only; same locked design, no reselection, no extra bandwise section
processing_connection: Not evaluated: saved fixed-geometry processing has support classes rather than a matched output for each of the 45 lag designs
numerics: Unchanged submission_revision.conditional_ranges, allowances, grid, fit and LP validation; width 2 penalty for invalid cases, validity reported separately
selected_designs_for_independent_check: numeric-lexicographic first, middle and last plus audit/H1/H2/historical designs
protected: All pre-existing configs, models, predictions, numerical tables and conditional ranges remain byte-identical
